title: Fun on the Bristol.
html_source: The New York musical-comedy version of Henry C. Jarret’s “American Eccentric Comedy-Oddity,” ‘Fun on the Bristol; or, A night on the Sound,’ was advertised as “funnier than a pantomime” and was enormously popular in the provinces in the late nineteenth century; together with Eugene Stratton’s recital, it constituted the Theatre Royal’s “double feature” for 16 June 1904.
